A luminance gradient is visible from the dark-grey exterior background to the high-white interior of the ring structures themselves.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of low-intensity (dark) solid pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, nested within the centers of the light annuli. The core pixel concentration is highest in the lower-central region of the torso.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of a large annulus on the upper right flank and two smaller annuli on the lower mid-section form an obtuse scalene triangle. A secondary cluster of three blobs on the lower right forms a tight, roughly linear geometric relationship.
